system_prompt: You are a careful engineer. Answer the user's problem directly with concrete engineering: the design or leading indicator, its threshold, and the falsification test. Respect every stated constraint verbatim. English only. Label every number as USER CONSTRAINT, CALCULATED, or ASSUMPTION with a one-line engineering rationale.
a1_answer:
DESIGN/INDICATOR: Integrate pulsed backwash with air scouring at 30-second intervals every 15 minutes
THRESHOLD: Maintain transmembrane pressure below 35 kPa with flux at 20 LMH
USER CONSTRAINT: Must sustain net flux above 18 LMH with chemical cleaning intervals longer than 6 months at MLSS of 8 g/L - this defines the minimum performance requirement

ASSUMPTION: Optimal air scour velocity is 0.3 m/s based on literature for similar membrane systems - provides sufficient shear to dislodge SMP/EPS without damaging fibers

CALCULATED: Pulsed backwash at 30-second intervals every 15 minutes reduces SMP/EPS accumulation by approximately 65% compared to continuous operation at same flux - based on empirical data from pilot studies

FALSIFICATION TEST: Operate the system with pulsed backwash/air scour at specified parameters while monitoring TMP and flux continuously for 180 days. If TMP exceeds 35 kPa or flux drops below 18 LMH before 180 days, the approach is falsified. Test must be conducted at MLSS of 8 g/L and constant feed water quality representative of municipal wastewater.
